title: Browser Agent v86 VM profile
description: Schema for source VM profiles in vm/profiles/*.json. Profiles are consumed by scripts/vm/build-profile.mjs to generate public v86 initramfs manifests.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing to this schema.

id.description: Stable profile identifier. Used as manifest filename, selector value and build id prefix.

name.description: Human-readable profile name shown in the UI.

description.description: Short profile summary shown in the UI and generated manifests.

type.description: Profile boot mode. Current builder creates initramfs-based images.

alpineVersion.description: Alpine version used to select the minirootfs, for example 3.23.4.

alpineBranch.description: Alpine repository branch, for example v3.23.

arch.description: Alpine architecture. v86 currently boots the 32-bit x86 profiles.

output.description: Output initramfs path relative to public/ or repository root.

kernelOutput.description: Output kernel path relative to public/ or repository root.

minRamMb.description: Minimum RAM shown for this profile in MB. Real minimum must be validated manually.

recommendedRamMb.description: Recommended RAM shown and applied by default in MB.

recommendedVramMb.description: Recommended VRAM shown and applied by default in MB.

defaultDisk.description: Default disk selector value. Use initramfs or one of the hda-* values supported by the UI.

packages.description: Alpine packages installed into the exported rootfs before packing the initramfs.

extraRepositories.description: Extra APK repositories appended after the main/community repositories.

firstBootCommands.description: Shell commands written to /etc/browser-agent-firstboot.sh and executed during VM boot.

buildCommands.description: Shell commands executed by scripts/vm/build-alpine-initramfs.sh against /rootfs during image generation.

validationCommands.description: Manual commands printed after build to validate the generated VM profile.

bootMessage.description: Message displayed on serial0 after first boot setup.

notes.description: Maintainer notes for profile-specific package/repository decisions.
